intended_object: This is a transport operation. It turns a homotopy F between f₀ and f₁ that satisfies the predicate P into a homotopy between g₀ and g₁, given proofs that f₀ = g₀ and f₁ = g₁. This reading comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition only rewrites the endpoints of a homotopy along propositional equalities. It keeps the same underlying map, reuses `Homotopy.cast`, and keeps the property P. This is a type-theoretic convenience for dependent types and has no mathematical object of its own. The body does exactly what the docstring says.
